content: Lewe Zarkketas Imettida Katamata
Iyarkko ginara Yordaanoose shaafappe he pinththan diza Mo7aabe dembaa bolla GODAY Muses hizgides,
«Isra7eele asay ba gishaappe gishaappe Lewe zarkketi daana katamatanne he katamata yuushon istti ba mehe izan heemmana gade immana mala yoota.
He katamatikka Lewe zarkketas duussaso gidana gides; mehe heemmizasohoti istta mehey pe7izaso gidana.
Katamata yuushon intte Lewe zarkketas immana mehe heenththa gadeza aakoteththay katamaa gimbezappe doommidi oyddu baggarakka 1,000 wadha wadha gido.
Hessa malan katamaza giddo aaththidi oyddu baggarakka gulappe biidi gula gakkanaas 2,000 wadha gido; hessa Lewe qommoti baas mehe heenththasoho histtetto.
Shemppo Wodhidayti Baqati Attiza Katamata
«Lewe qommotas intte immiza katamatappe usuppunati as wodhida asi baqati attiza katamata gidetto; heytappe hara 42 katamata gujji immite.
Istti mehe heemmizasohotara gujjiin 48 katamati imettetto.
Isra7eele zarkketi laattida gadeppe istta gade gade dalgateththaa mala dalga gade oykkidaytappe dalga, xunththa gade oykkidaytappe xunth ekkidi Lewe zarkketas immite.»
GODAY Muses hizgi yootides,
«Neni Isra7eele asaas, ‹Intte Kanaane dere gelanaas Yordaanoose shaafaa pinniza wode,
issi asi erontta dishe as wodhikko hessaadey baqati biidi attana katamata ne doora.
He katamati shemppo wodhidaadey pirdas shiiqontta dishin hayqqidaade dabboy iza wodhontta mala izi baqati attiza katamata gidetto.
Hayti intte Lewetas immida usuppun katamati erontta shemppo wodhida asi baqati attiza katamata gidana.
He katamatappe heedzdzati Yordaanoose shaafaappe he pinththan arshey mokkiza baggara hankko heedzdzati qasse Kanaane biittan gidetto.
Ha usuppun katamati erontta dishe as wodhida Isra7eele asi, imaththatinne intte giddon diza hara dere asati baqati attizaso gidetto.
Suuththa Azareth
« ‹Issi asi biratappe oosettidaazan as wodhidaa gidikko he shemppo wodhidaadey izikka asa kushen hayqqo.
Issi asi shuchchan caddidi as wodhidaa gidikko he shemppo wodhidaadey izikka asa kushen hayqqo.
Issi asi miththan caddi as wodhidaa gidikko he shemppo wodhidaadeyka asa kushen hayqqo.
He hayqqidayssas mata dabboy suuth azaranaas dandayza gishshas awanka demmiko wodhanaas dandayees.
« ‹Issi asi odidi as sugi yeggi wodhikko woykko geemason uttidi issi miishshan caddi,

wodhikko morkketeththan dendidi icci wodhikko izi shemppo wodhida gishshas izikka asa kushen hayqqanaas bessees; he hayqqidayssas mata dabboy suuth accanaas dandayza gishshas awanka demmiko wodhanaas dandayees.
« ‹Gido attiin issi asi erontta dishe as sugi wodhikko woykko qoppontta dishe issi miishshan caddi wodhikko,
woykko erontta dishe shuch iza bolla yeggi wodhizaa gidikko hessaadey iza qohanaas odi ooththontta gishshas,
derezi he wodhidayssa giddoninne hayqqidayssa dabbota giddon imettana pirday hayssafe kaallizayssa gido.
Erontta dishe as wodhidaadey suuth acciza asa kusheppe derezi ashshidi izi baqati attida katama zaaro; zayten tiyettida qeeseta halaqay hayqqana gakkanaas izi heen gam7o.
« ‹As wodhidi kasasetidayssi baqati attiza katamaappe kare kezizaa gidikko,
suuththa accizaadey demmidi iza wodhikko suuththa acon oyshettenna.
As wodhidi kasasetidayssi qeeseta halaqay hayqqana gakkanaas baqati attiza katamaan gam7o; qeeseta halaqazi hayqqidaappe guye izi baso simmana dandayees.
« ‹Hayssi ha wogazi intte diza dere ubbaan inttessinne intte zereththatas eqqi diza woga gido.
« ‹Shempo wodhida ay asikka hayqo pirda pirdettanaas dandayzay iza bolla nam7u markkay woykko izappe bollara markkattiko attiin issi markkan xalla hayqo qixaate ekkenna.
Shemppo wodhiin hayqo pirday iza bolla pirdettida asi hayqqana bessees attiin ba wodhida shemppo gishshas miishshe qanxxi attanaas dandayenna.
Izan baqati attiza katama baqatida oonappeka qeeseta halaqay hayqqanaappe kase izi guye simmidi ba biittan de7ana mala giidi suuththa qanxxo ekkofte.
Intte hessaththo ooththizaa gidikko intte biittaa tuniseeta; gaasoykka asa suuth gussizayssi biitta tunisees; he biittay geeyanay asa suuth gussidaade suuththay gukkiin attiin haran geeyenna.
Tani intte GODAA gidida gishshassinne inttenara Isra7eele dereza giddon diza gishshas tani izan diza biittaa tunisopite› ga yoota.»
